# Game Idea

**Orbit Dodge** – A spacecraft continuously orbits a planet on an HTML canvas. The player adjusts the ship’s orbital radius and speed to dodge randomly spawning meteors. The game ends (lose condition) if the ship collides with a meteor or runs out of fuel.

- Draw planet at center (circle). Draw ship (triangle) at orbit position. Draw meteors (circles).

- Game loop using requestAnimationFrame.
